title: Configure Trigger Conditions, Actions, and Throttling
objectives: Configure Trigger Conditions, Actions, and Throttling
Verify shared configuration, actual results and retained execution evidence.

tasks.instruction: The fixture supplies three explicit source_logs events and pauses the clock. Keep it paused while configuring; advance deliberately for scheduled work.
Create HTTP throttled alert in search, owner admin, Private. Search index=source_logs | stats count by status over -15m to now. Schedule every minute.
Set number of events > 0, trigger for each result, suppression on for 5m with status as the suppression field, tracking on and a local notification action.

Advance twice across minute boundaries. Two different status results must trigger once each; both repeats must be suppressed. Inspect run provenance and Triggered Alerts. No real email or network action is sent.

hints: Inspect native configuration and the selected namespace. File edits need activation.
Check search results before diagnosing alert conditions or dashboard rendering.
